# butterchurn-mcp — Full Reference

> MilkDrop-style audio-reactive WebGL visualizer via butterchurn. FastMCP 3.4+
> server with BPM sync for mixx-dj-mcp. Dual transport: stdio (default) and HTTP
> with MCP at `/mcp`. Full-screen Vite dashboard on `:10879` proxies to the API on
> `:10878`.

## Table of Contents

- [Quick start](#quick-start)

## Quick start

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/butterchurn-mcp
cd butterchurn-mcp
uv sync
cd webapp; bun install; cd ..
.\start.ps1     # backend :10878 + frontend :10879, opens browser
```

Or run separately: `uv run butterchurn-mcp --serve` (backend) and `cd webapp; bun run dev` (frontend).

## Architecture

```
browser (Vite SPA :10879)
   │  /api/*  /health  /mcp   (proxied to backend)
   ▼
FastAPI + FastMCP HTTP (:10878)
   ├── /api/bpm  GET/POST  →  bpm_state (in-memory)
   ├── /mcp                 →  FastMCP stdio-compatible MCP endpoint
   └── /api/logs            →  log_buffer (in-memory ring)
```

- **Transport**: stdio by default (`uv run butterchurn-mcp`); HTTP via
  `--serve` (FastAPI hosting the MCP endpoint at `/mcp`).
- **BPM state**: a single in-memory value (default 128). `set_bpm` writes it;
  the webapp polls `/api/bpm` every 2s and re-times the visualizer's beat
  generator.
- **WebGL rendering**: butterchurn runs entirely in the browser. The Python
  backend serves data + APIs; no frames are streamed from Python.

## Ports

| Role | Port |
|------|------|
| Backend (FastAPI + MCP HTTP) | 10878 |
| Frontend (Vite dev) | 10879 |

Ports are configurable via `BUTTERCHURN_MCP_HOST` / `BUTTERCHURN_MCP_PORT`.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `BUTTERCHURN_MCP_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Bind host for the HTTP server |
| `BUTTERCHURN_MCP_PORT` | `10878` | Backend port |
| `BUTTERCHURN_MCP_HTTP_PATH` | `/mcp` | Path the MCP HTTP endpoint is mounted at |
| `BUTTERCHURN_MCP_DEFAULT_BPM` | `128` | Initial BPM shown until set |

## REST API

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/health`, `/api/health`, `/api/v1/health` | GET | Status, version, uptime, current BPM |
| `/api/capabilities` | GET | Server + tool surface + features inventory |
| `/api/visualizers` | GET | Engine catalog (shader scenes + butterchurn) |
| `/api/dashboard` | GET | BPM, uptime, preset library, engine list |
| `/api/tools` | GET | MCP tool list |
| `/api/skills` | GET | Bundled skills (if any) |
| `/api/logs?limit&level&search` | GET | Recent server log entries |
| `/api/bpm` | GET | Current BPM |
| `/api/bpm` | POST `{"bpm": 140}` | Set BPM (60–200) |

## MCP tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `get_bpm` | Read current BPM driving the visualizer beat generator |
| `set_bpm(bpm)` | Set BPM (60–200) for mixx-dj-mcp sync; logs the change |

MCP registration name in clients: `butterchurn` (short alias).

## Webapp

Routes: Dashboard · Toolbox · Presets · Visualizer · Tools · Skills · Chat ·
Settings · Logs · Help.

- **Toolbox** (`/toolbox`): engine picker + scene grid + live preview.
- **Presets** (`/presets`): live gallery of every butterchurn visualizer. Each
  thumbnail renders its own animated preview (cards activate on scroll, ~12
  concurrent WebGL contexts max) with search, category/author filters,
  favorites, slideshow, and fullscreen.
- **Visualizer** (`/visualizer`): fullscreen canvas; `?engine=shader&scene=…` or
  `?engine=butterchurn&i=<preset-index>`.
- **Fullscreen** link from a preset jumps to `/visualizer?i=<index>`.

## Visualizer engines

| Engine | Era | Runtime | Content |
|--------|-----|---------|---------|
| `shader` | modern | WebGL2 GLSL | 6 bundled scenes (gyroid-pulse, neon-tunnel, spectrum-rings, plasma-flow, cosmic-bloom, neon-grid) |
| `butterchurn` | legacy | butterchurn + MilkDrop | ~2,000 presets: `butterchurn-presets` (Main/Extra/Extra2/MD1/Minimal/Non-Minimal) + projectM Original (513, eager) + Cream Geo (996, lazy) + Cream Particles (375, lazy) |

## Troubleshooting

- **Launcher never returns / no browser**: both servers are detached; check the
  ports are listening (`Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 10878,10879`). If the
  backend crashed, `uv run butterchurn-mcp --serve` in a terminal shows the
  traceback.
- **`ModuleNotFoundError: dotenv`**: run `uv sync --reinstall-package python-dotenv`.
- **Frontend blank / vite not found**: `start.ps1` needs `bun` on PATH or at
  `~\.bun\bin\bun.exe`. Start it manually with `cd webapp; bun run dev`.

See [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) for more.
